cases.title: A higher layer caps a lower one
cases.when: Each layer sets the same limit with values above and below the layer above
then: Values above a higher layer are rejected at save naming the limiting layer

cases.title: Same-layer conflicts are rejected
cases.when: Two tool-group overrides set the same field
then: Rejected at save, never resolved by timestamp

cases.title: Pool beats tool group beats tenant-wide inside a binding
Lowering a higher layer caps bindings in a new revision
cases.when: Tenant policy is lowered below a binding value
then: The binding shows "capped by tenant policy" and a new revision has the effective value

cases.title: Env-owned values are read-only
cases.when: A PATCH sets an env-owned field, and an import contains one
then: The PATCH is rejected; the import excludes it; the console shows it read-only

cases.title: The effective value API names the source layer
then: Every field has its value and the layer it came from

cases.title: The binding digest is part of the permit
cases.when: The binding changes after a permit is minted
then: Admission checks the admitted binding digest
